description: Read one behaviour test run for one of your agents, with every scenario's result. In early access: it answers released false or not_released until it is switched on for your workspace. Runs never send real mail. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: The agent to test: its id, as an agent shows in your workspace. An agent's own credential can name only its own agent.

run_id.description: The run: its id, as run_agent_behaviour_tests or get_agent_behaviour_tests returned it.

name: get_agent_behaviour_test_run
